hypothesis: Prefix matching reduces failed vegetarian-menu searches on mobile.
primary_outcome: independently verified task success within budget
change_under_test: ranking only; hold UI and corpus fixed
order_policy: seeded counterbalanced schedule, persisted in assignment ledger
exposure_rule: at least 50 percent visible for 500 ms; deduplicate within result instance
retry_policy: retain failures; repair harness in separate batch
pilot: one satisfiable and one impossible task per variant; exclude from measurement
scenario_origin: illustrative expert hypotheses, not observed customer demand

scenarios.task: Find a vegetarian main dish using mobile menu search.
scenarios.worker_preferences: Prefer a main dish over a side; stop if effort budget is exhausted.
scenarios.private_oracle: Verify selected item is a main dish and vegetarian in the trusted fixture; never infer dietary status from a name.

calibration: none yet; diagnostic synthetic evidence only
